newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton Energy to launch wells in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton Energy to launch wells in 1997.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said on Monday it will continue drilling for natural gas on a parcel in Washington County, Texas throughout 1997.

Hugoton's first natural gas well on the site began production last Friday, setting a new record of 30 million cubic feet per day, said the company. The 21,000-acre site has up to 20 additional drilling locations, Hugoton said.
The company said it also will begin drilling exploratory wells on a 100,000-acre site in Louisiana that contains as many as 50 drilling locations.
Hugoton is an independent oil and natural gas company.
